title: Revenue Maximum
description: Two-panel interactive simulation showing the relationship between price, quantity demanded, and total revenue, demonstrating where maximum revenue occurs on the demand curve
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Economics
Microeconomics
Revenue
Demand Curve
Price Optimization
prerequisites: Basic understanding of supply and demand
learningObjectives: Calculate total revenue as price times quantity demanded and identify it as the shaded rectangle under the demand curve
Explain the inverse relationship between price and quantity demanded shown by the downward-sloping demand curve
Predict how raising price above the revenue-maximizing point causes total revenue to fall even though each unit earns more
Identify the price at the peak of the parabolic revenue curve as the revenue-maximizing price
Analyze why the revenue curve is a parabola given the linear demand relationship Revenue = Price × (MaxQuantity − Price)
